title: New Attacks Hit Riyadh Airport as Regional Tensions Grow
subtitle: A second strike at the Saudi capital's main airport follows a deadly missile attack that killed twelve people.

summary.en: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was hit by a new attack on Sunday, just one day after a deadly missile strike killed twelve people. The Houthi group in Yemen has claimed responsibility for both attacks, which also targeted energy facilities. Saudi authorities confirmed the latest strike caused injuries, though the exact number remains unclear. The violence has forced the airport to close and raised concerns about global oil prices. International leaders are now watching the situation closely as the risk of a wider conflict increases.
summary.zh: 位於利雅德的哈立德國王國際機場於週日遭到新一波攻擊，距離前一日造成十二人死亡的致命飛彈襲擊僅過了一天。葉門的胡塞組織已宣稱對這兩起同樣鎖定能源設施的攻擊負責。沙烏地當局證實最新一波攻擊造成人員受傷，但確切人數尚不明朗。暴力事件迫使機場關閉，並引發對全球油價的擔憂。隨著爆發更大規模衝突的風險增加，國際領導人正密切關注局勢發展。

paragraphs.en: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was struck again on Sunday, only one day after a major attack killed twelve people and injured hundreds. Saudi authorities reported that an unidentified object hit Terminal 4, while air defense systems destroyed a cruise missile nearby. This second attack has caused further injuries, though officials have not yet provided a specific number of victims. The airport remains closed following the violence.
paragraphs.zh: 位於利雅德的哈立德國王國際機場（King Khalid International Airport）於週日再次遭到攻擊，距離前一日造成十二人死亡、數百人受傷的重大襲擊僅過了一天。沙烏地阿拉伯當局指出，一個不明物體擊中了第四航廈，而防空系統則在附近摧毀了一枚巡弋飛彈。這起二次攻擊造成了更多傷亡，儘管官員尚未提供具體的受害者人數。目前機場因暴力事件持續關閉。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the twelve people killed in Saturday’s attack included citizens from Egypt, Syria, and India. The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia confirmed that one of its citizens, who was among the many injured on Saturday, later died in the hospital. The embassy expressed its sadness and stated that it is working to help the family of the deceased. Saturday’s attack was particularly severe, with over 300 people reported injured, making it one of the deadliest incidents in the region since the current conflict began.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，週六襲擊中喪生的十二人包含埃及、敘利亞與印度的公民。印度駐沙烏地阿拉伯大使館證實，其中一名在週六受傷的公民隨後在醫院不治身亡。大使館對此表達哀悼，並表示正致力於協助死者家屬。週六的攻擊極為嚴重，據報有超過三百人受傷，使其成為當前衝突爆發以來，該地區最致命的事件之一。

paragraphs.en: Yemen’s Houthi group has claimed responsibility for both the Saturday and Sunday attacks. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree stated that the group carried out several operations using missiles and drones. Beyond the airport in Riyadh, the group also claimed to have targeted Dammam airport and energy facilities belonging to the Saudi oil company, Aramco. The Houthis warned travelers and airlines to stay away from Saudi airports, claiming that the Saudi government is responsible for any failed attempts to stop their missiles.
paragraphs.zh: 葉門的胡塞組織（Houthi）已宣稱對週六與週日的兩起攻擊負責。胡塞軍事發言人葉海亞·薩里（Yahya Saree）表示，該組織利用飛彈與無人機執行了多次行動。除了利雅德的機場外，該組織亦聲稱鎖定了達曼機場以及沙烏地石油公司「阿美」（Aramco）的能源設施。胡塞組織警告旅客與航空公司遠離沙烏地機場，並聲稱沙烏地政府應為任何攔截飛彈失敗的後果負責。

paragraphs.en: These attacks have created significant worry regarding global oil supplies. The incidents occurred just before the World Petroleum Congress, a major international energy meeting scheduled to take place in Riyadh. Because of the danger, it is currently unclear if the leaders of major energy companies like Shell, ExxonMobil, and BP will attend. NPR reports that the repeated attacks have already caused a temporary stop in oil flows and pushed global oil prices higher. Saudi energy minister, Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud, spoke at the conference, stating that the kingdom remains strong and will continue its work despite the threats.
paragraphs.zh: 這些攻擊引發了對全球石油供應的重大擔憂。事件發生在「世界石油大會」（World Petroleum Congress）召開前夕，這是一場原定於利雅德舉行的重要國際能源會議。由於危險性增加，目前尚不清楚殼牌（Shell）、艾克森美孚（ExxonMobil）與英國石油（BP）等大型能源公司的高層是否會出席。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，反覆的攻擊已導致石油運輸暫時中斷，並推高了全球油價。沙烏地能源部長阿卜杜勒阿齊茲·本·薩爾曼·阿勒沙烏地親王（Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud）在會議上發言，表示沙烏地王國依然強大，儘管面臨威脅，仍將持續運作。

paragraphs.en: This escalation has brought international attention to the conflict. NPR reports that President Donald Trump is considering how the United States might get involved, as the Saudi government has asked for help with air defense. Saudi Arabia is currently running low on the equipment needed to stop incoming missiles and has reached out to countries like France, Britain, Pakistan, and Egypt for support. Meanwhile, the United Arab Emirates has expressed its support for Saudi Arabia, which is a notable change after a period of difficult relations between the two nations.
paragraphs.zh: 局勢升級已將國際目光引向這場衝突。NPR 報導指出，川普（Donald Trump）總統正在研議美國可能介入的方式，因為沙烏地政府已請求協助防空。沙烏地阿拉伯目前攔截來襲飛彈所需的裝備短缺，已向法國、英國、巴基斯坦與埃及等國尋求支援。與此同時，阿拉伯聯合大公國表達了對沙烏地阿拉伯的支持，這在兩國經歷一段關係緊張的時期後，是一個顯著的轉變。

paragraphs.en: The situation is further complicated by claims from both sides. While the Houthis continue their attacks, they also reported that a Saudi airstrike hit a house in the Yemeni capital of Sanaa, killing a child and wounding others. The Houthi-run health ministry claimed that 91 Yemenis have been killed by the Saudi-led coalition over the past five weeks. Saudi authorities have not provided an immediate comment on these specific claims.
paragraphs.zh: 雙方各執一詞，使局勢更加複雜。在胡塞組織持續發動攻擊的同時，他們亦指控沙烏地空襲了葉門首都沙那的一處民宅，造成一名兒童死亡及多人受傷。由胡塞組織運作的衛生部聲稱，過去五週內已有九十一名葉門人死於沙烏地領導的聯軍之手。沙烏地當局尚未針對這些具體指控立即發表評論。

paragraphs.en: As the airport remains closed, the future of the region looks uncertain. The conflict has moved beyond local fighting, now directly affecting international travel, energy markets, and the safety of civilians in major cities. With the Houthis threatening more attacks and the Saudi government seeking international military aid, the risk of a larger, more dangerous conflict is growing. Leaders in the region and around the world are now waiting to see if the situation can be controlled or if the cycle of violence will continue to expand.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著機場持續關閉，該地區的未來充滿不確定性。衝突已超越局部戰鬥，直接影響國際旅遊、能源市場以及大城市平民的安全。隨著胡塞組織威脅發動更多攻擊，且沙烏地政府尋求國際軍事援助，爆發更大規模、更危險衝突的風險正在增加。區域內與全球的領導人正密切關注局勢是否能受到控制，抑或暴力循環將持續擴大。

quiz.explanationZh: 根據文章第二段，印度大使館確認一名印度公民在週六的襲擊中受傷，隨後在醫院過世。選項 A 錯誤，因為該公民並非當場死亡；選項 C 與事實相反，因為文中明確指出該公民受傷；選項 D 文中並未提及撤離至大使館的細節，僅提到大使館正在協助家屬。
